function.description: Query or record persistent project idioms, rules, dependencies, and architectural decisions.
function.name: manage_knowledge

category.description: Classification category for the knowledge entry.

value.description: Value or rule description to persist.

function.description: Execute a command in a Linux shell (bash, zsh, or sh) to run builds, tests, git, package managers, etc. Standard Unix commands only (ls, cat, grep, rm, etc.).
function.name: run_command

background.description: Run command in background as a managed service without blocking the turn.

command.description: The bash/zsh shell command to execute.

cwd.description: Optional subdirectory to run the command in.

service_name.description: Unique name for the background service (required if background is true).

timeout_secs.description: Execution timeout in seconds (default: 60; clamped to NEXUS_MAX_TOOL_TIMEOUT_SECS, default 1800).

function.description: Auto-detect and run the project test suite (cargo test, npm test, pytest, make test) with parsed failures and compiler diagnostics.
function.name: run_tests

filter.description: Optional test name filter or pattern to isolate specific unit tests.

function.description: Spawn an isolated subagent with its own dedicated context to investigate code, search files, or verify implementations without cluttering the main conversation history.
function.name: spawn_subagent

prompt.description: The specific objective or question for the subagent to solve.

function.description: Signal that the overall task is finished and report a short final summary of the changes.
function.name: task_completed

notes.description: Any instructions, follow-up recommendations, or verification steps.

summary.description: Short summary (2-4 sentences): what changed and how it was checked.

function.description: Create or update the task's plan: a short checklist, one item per phase, each a few words.
function.name: update_plan

name.description: The item, in a few words.

function.description: Generate unified diff of repository changes natively via Rust libgit2 engine.
function.name: git_diff

path_filter.description: Optional file path pattern to restrict diff to.

staged.description: If true, diff staged changes against HEAD. Otherwise diff working directory.

function.description: Inspect recent commit history (author, hash, summary, timestamp) natively via Rust libgit2 engine.
function.name: git_log

max_commits.description: Maximum number of commits to retrieve (default: 10).

function.description: Inspect native repository branch and staged/modified/untracked files via Rust libgit2 engine.
function.name: git_status

function.description: Query Language Server Protocol (LSP) definition location for a symbol at a given line and character.
function.name: lsp_definition

character.description: The 1-indexed character offset on the line.

path.description: The source file path containing the symbol reference.

function.description: Retrieve active Language Server Protocol (LSP) semantic compiler diagnostics for a source file.
function.name: lsp_diagnostics

path.description: The source file path to query diagnostics for.

function.description: Query Language Server Protocol (LSP) hover documentation and type signatures for a symbol at a given line and character.
function.name: lsp_hover

character.description: The 1-indexed character offset on the line.

path.description: The source file path to inspect.

function.description: Load the complete instructions, workflow, and guidelines of a specialized agent skill into active context.
function.name: activate_skill

name.description: The name of the skill to activate (e.g. 'graphify').

function.description: Click an interactive DOM element on the active browser page by CSS selector or element ID.
function.name: browser_click

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to click (e.g. '#submit-btn' or 'button.login').

function.description: Inspect browser console logs, warnings, and uncaught exceptions for frontend diagnostics.
function.name: browser_console_logs

limit.description: Maximum recent log entries to return (default: 50).

function.description: Navigate the headless browser to a local development server URL (e.g. http://localhost:3000), web page, or HTML file for runtime verification.
function.name: browser_navigate

url.description: The complete HTTP/HTTPS URL or local HTML file path to load.

function.description: Capture a viewport screenshot of the active browser page to verify frontend layout or UI state.
function.name: browser_screenshot

output_path.description: Optional destination file path for screenshot PNG (defaults to .nexus/screenshots/).

function.description: Type text into an input field or textarea on the active browser page.
function.name: browser_type

selector.description: CSS selector of target input element.

text.description: Text to enter into the target field.

function.description: Fetch web content, documentation, or JSON API from an HTTP/HTTPS URL. Strips HTML markup.
function.name: fetch_web

url.description: The complete HTTP or HTTPS URL to fetch.

function.description: Search the web for programming documentation, error messages, library APIs, and technical solutions.
function.name: search_web

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return (default: 5).

query.description: The technical search query (e.g. 'rust axum json extraction example').

function.description: Read multiple files in parallel in a single turn to eliminate multi-turn round trips.
function.name: batch_read

length.description: Maximum number of bytes to read per file (optional; maximum 8 MB).

max_lines_per_file.description: Maximum number of lines to read per file (default: 500).

offset.description: Byte offset to begin reading each file (optional; required if file exceeds 8 MB).

paths.description: List of relative paths to files to read.

function.description: Delete a file or directory inside the workspace. A directory needs recursive: true. The workspace root and .git cannot be deleted.
function.name: delete_file

path.description: Relative path to file or directory to remove.

recursive.description: Required to delete a directory and everything in it.

function.description: Perform a safe search-and-replace on a file. Replaces old_content with new_content and returns the diff.
function.name: edit_file

old_content.description: Exact snippet of text in the file to be replaced.

path.description: Relative path to the file to edit.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence of old_content. Without it, old_content must occur exactly once.

function.description: Inspect detailed metadata of a file or directory (size in bytes, permissions, line count, binary check, modified timestamp).
function.name: file_info

path.description: Relative path to the file or directory.

function.description: Render a hierarchical Unicode directory tree of the workspace, respecting .gitignore and ignoring hidden files.
function.name: file_tree

function.description: Quickly locate files matching a glob or substring pattern (e.g. '*.rs', '**/*.ts', 'auth'). Respects .gitignore.
function.name: find_files

pattern.description: Glob or substring pattern to search for.

function.description: List files and directories in the workspace, respecting .gitignore and ignoring hidden files.
function.name: list_dir

path.description: Subdirectory to list (defaults to workspace root '.').

function.description: Apply a standard unified diff patch or hunk to a file.
function.name: patch_file

patch.description: Unified diff or hunk content (including @@ headers or -/+ lines).

path.description: Relative path to the file to patch.

function.description: Read the contents of a file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line for specific ranges, or offset and length to page through large files (>8 MB limit).
function.name: read_file

length.description: Maximum number of bytes to read (optional; maximum 8 MB).

offset.description: Byte offset from the start of the file to begin reading (optional; required if file exceeds 8 MB).

path.description: Relative path to the file within the workspace.

function.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with the provided content. One reply can hold only a limited amount of output: write a long file (more than a few hundred lines) in parts, a first part here and the rest with edit_file, or as several smaller files.
function.name: write_file

content.description: Complete text content of the file.

overwrite.description: Must be true if replacing an existing file.

path.description: Relative path to the file to create or overwrite.

function.description: Parse symbols, multiline signatures, doc comments, visibility, and scopes using the Rust CST parser.
function.name: cst_symbols

path.description: File or directory path to parse.

function.description: Perform hybrid code search blending dense semantic embeddings, sparse Okapi BM25, and Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). Ideal for discovering code by intent or meaning when exact keyword tokens are unknown.
function.name: hybrid_search

mode.description: Search mode: 'hybrid' (blended RRF, default), 'semantic' (vector embeddings), or 'lexical' (BM25 keyword).

path.description: Optional relative directory path to scope search.

query.description: Natural language query or code concept to search for.

function.description: Generate a compact AST skeleton outline of a source file (functions, classes, interfaces, signatures, and line numbers) to conserve context before reading specific line ranges.
function.name: outline_file

path.description: Relative path to the source file to outline.

function.description: High-performance code search across the workspace (ripgrep speed). Respects .gitignore.
function.name: search_code

file_pattern.description: Optional regex to filter filenames (e.g. '\.rs$' or '\.ts$').

is_regex.description: Whether query is a regular expression (default: false).

max_results.description: Maximum number of matching lines to return (default: 50).

query.description: Search string or regex pattern to search for.

function.description: Search for function, struct, class, interface, trait, or type declarations across the codebase (AST-level symbol search).
function.name: search_symbols

max_results.description: Maximum number of symbols to return (default: 50).

query.description: Optional symbol name or substring to filter declarations.

function.description: Ultra-fast code search accelerated by Rust inverted trigram index.
function.name: trigram_search

path.description: Optional subdirectory to restrict search to.

query.description: Substring or token to search for across the codebase.
